author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect).** proto-blue-lexicon (or proto-blue umbrella) on polaris-frontend deps. New polaris-frontend/src/validation.rs builds Registry from embedded lexicon JSON (mirroring polaris-publish-labeler-record's load_client_metadata pattern). ActionComposer signal calls Registry::validate() with 50ms debounce. Errors as typed LexValidationError variants render inline. xtask check-wasm-symbols reads release artifact and asserts lexicon symbol presence. Native unit tests for Registry + composer integration; headless wasm-bindgen-test source shipped, gate on feature flag (sandbox may lack chromedriver). Bundle-budget gate filed as #71 if not in scope here.
